topics.title: Program Director Requests Increased Funding
topics.summary: During a radio program, the station director requests additional funding from his superiors. He attempts to solicit callers who will advocate for increased funds but faces criticism regarding Howard Stern’s comments about African Americans and receives numerous calls expressing opinions on the show's content.

topics.title: Host Rant About Liz Smith’s Negative Review
topics.summary: During an impromptu discussion, hosts express extreme dissatisfaction with the film *Total Recall*, dismissing it as revolting and poorly made. They delve into details of Liz Smith's past—her husband disappearing in 1952—and speculate about her motivations for criticizing Arnold Schwarzenegger, concluding she’s a bitter woman.

topics.title: Stern Criticizes TV Plans, Newspaper Inaccuracies
topics.summary: Howard Stern expresses frustration over Channel Nine’s rushed plans for a television version of his show and criticizes network pressure. He disputes inaccuracies reported by the newspaper regarding Elaine Boozler's reporting, questioning their credibility while also referencing delays with other radio personalities like Rick Deese.

topics.title: Radio Show Revamp Struggles
topics.summary: Several New York radio stations are attempting to revamp their morning shows with new hosts and long-term contracts, aiming for increased listenership. Confusion persists as promotional efforts fail to gain traction, personalities shift, and the value of contractual commitments is questioned amidst ongoing station instability.

topics.title: Radio Host Discusses Serial Rapist & Gay Film Festival
topics.summary: During the broadcast, Fred Knox discusses a serial rapist in Queens with seven victims described by detectives as wearing a dark hooded sweatshirt and having a West Indian accent. He then transitions to an awkward discussion about the upcoming Gay Film Festival, expressing curiosity but finding it unsettling.

topics.title: Gay Film Festival Reactions
topics.summary: During an audio recording, two individuals discuss attending a gay film festival, expressing discomfort and amusement at the films’ content – primarily focusing on scenes depicting homosexual intimacy. They repeatedly express disgust with the films' subject matter, often referencing physical reactions like vomiting or groaning in response to explicit scenes, and frequently discussing other notable films within the festival lineup.
